ShowToPlayers.Name: Show the almanac to players
ShowToPlayers.Hint: When off, only the GM sees the date and time display. Rest scenes still play for everyone.

Scale.Name: Almanac size
Scale.Hint: Drag the almanac to move it. Double-click it to send it back to the top of the screen.

Theme.Name: Colour theme
Theme.Hint: Applies to the almanac, the rest scene and the almanac settings window for everyone in this world. With Grim Core active, the theme is chosen there instead.

ReverseDial.Name: Turn the dial the other way
ReverseDial.Hint: Flips the direction the sun and moon travel around the dial as time passes.

Rest.Until: {hours} hours pass. The party rises at {time}, {date}.
Rest.UntilOne: 1 hour passes. The party moves on at {time}, {date}.
Rest.NoActors: No player-owned characters found. Only the clock will move.
Rest.NoSystem: Character recovery needs the D&D 5e system. Only the clock will move.
Rest.Failed: The rest could not be applied to {name}. Check the console for details.

Config.Title: Grim Almanac
Config.MenuHint: Set the date, time, weather and calendar.
Config.SetDateHint: Setting the date re-labels the present moment. World time does not move, so active effects are not expired.
Config.AdvanceHint: These move world time, so effect durations count down with them.
Config.ResetPosition: Move my almanac back to the top
Config.DisplayHint: The theme is shared by the whole table. Size, 12/24-hour clock and °C/°F are per player, under Configure Settings → Grim Almanac.
Config.WeatherAuto: Roll new weather each day from the season and climate
Config.WeatherAutoHint: On: temperature rises toward mid-afternoon and falls overnight; whatever you save below holds until the next dawn roll. Off: your values stay until you change them.
Config.CalendarHint: A festival is a short month that sits between two others. Set Days to 0 and Leap days to 1 for a day that exists only in leap years.

Core.Managed: Grim Core sets the colour theme for every Grim module (now: {theme}). Change it there.
